title: Why Pen Caps Have A Tiny Hole 😮

shots.vo: Look at the cap of a cheap pen. There's a tiny hole in the top.
shots.prompt: extreme close-up of a blue plastic ballpoint pen cap with a tiny hole in its tip, macro photography, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name

shots.vo: Most people think it stops the ink drying out.

shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name

shots.vo: It doesn't. That hole is there to save your life.

shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name

shots.vo: Kids chew pen caps. And sometimes, they swallow them.

shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name

shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name

shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
